title: Grilled Garlic-Herb Pizzas with Fennel, Roasted Tomatoes and Asiago
changes_from_base: A crunchy cornmeal crust flavoured with garlic-herb oil is cooked on a covered barbecue instead of a hot oven, then topped with soft sautéed onion and fennel, roasted plum tomato halves and a sprinkle of Asiago in place of tomato sauce and mozzarella.
summary: Eight small garlic-herb pizzas cooked on the barbecue with a soft, sweet fennel and onion topping, roasted plum tomatoes and a sprinkle of grated Asiago.

ingredients.item: dried herbes de Provence (or dried thyme)
fine sea salt or table salt
very large onion, halved and thinly sliced
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Herb Oil
steps.text: Warm oil (30 ml) with chopped garlic (3 cloves), herbs (½ tsp herbes de Provence) and pepper (1 tsp) in a small pan over low about 5 min until soft, cool.

steps.title: Activate Yeast
steps.text: Sprinkle yeast (7 g) and sugar (1 tsp) over warm water (60 ml) and leave 5 min until it swells.

steps.title: Make Dough
steps.text: Pulse bread flour (405 g), cornmeal (40 g) and salt (2 tsp) in the processor, add cool water (235 ml) and herb oil to the yeast, pour into the running machine until a rough ball forms, rest 5 min, process about 35 s until smooth, knead briefly, put in an oiled bowl, cover and rise about 2 h until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 8, roll into balls, cover and rest 30 min, roll each to an 18 cm round and lay on floured trays.

steps.title: Cook Fennel
steps.text: Heat oil (45 ml) in a sauté pan over medium-high, cook onion (1 very large, 550 g sliced) and fennel (1 medium bulb, sliced) about 8 min until soft, add sliced garlic (4 cloves) for 2 min, then thyme (1 tsp), fennel seeds (1 tsp), chilli flakes (¼ tsp) and salt (¼ tsp).

steps.title: Roast Tomatoes
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C, brush plum tomato halves (12 small) with oil (45 ml), season and roast 20-30 min until just tender.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Heat the barbecue to hot, brush the tops of 4 rounds with some of the remaining oil (60 ml) and salt, grill oiled side down, lid closed, 1-1.5 min until marked, popping any bubbles, brush the tops with oil, flip, spread with fennel mixture, add 3 tomato halves each, scatter Asiago (30 g grated), drizzle with oil, close the lid and grill 2-3 min until crisp underneath, repeat with remaining dough.

tips: No barbecue? Cook the rounds in a very hot ridged griddle pan, then top them and finish under a hot grill for 1-2 min until the cheese melts.
Roast the tomatoes and cook the fennel mixture separately so each achieves the right texture and colour on its own timeline
Watch the pizzas closely on the barbecue as the bases char quickly; pop any bubbles that form and move them if they start to burn
storage: Best eaten straight away whilst the crust is still warm and crisp from the grill. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
